description: Create, drop, or index a property on an IRIS document database. 'create' defines a new property with a specified type and fills it from the document field at 'path' (default '$.<property>', the top-level field of the same name). Documents saved before the property exists are not filled in until they are saved again. DocDB indexes every property it creates, so a created property is already indexed. 'drop' removes a property definition. 'index' reports an existing property as indexed without writing anything, and creates a property that does not exist yet (a %String read from 'path'). A system property (a name starting with '%') cannot be indexed. Prerequisite: the %Service_DocDB service must be enabled on the instance (it is disabled by default on IRIS) — a disabled service fails these calls with ERROR #822: Access Denied.

path.description: Document path the property is read from, for 'create' and for 'index' of a property that does not exist yet (default '$.<property>', e.g. '$.address.city'). Ignored by 'drop' and by 'index' of an existing property.

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.
